content: Muse higgey yaanaw de7iya lo77obatas kuyape attishin, ba huuphen waanna gidenna. Hessa gisho, laythan laythan pacey bayna yarshetiya yarshoy goyinnanaw shiiqiya asaa polo oothanaw danda7enna.
Higgey enta polo oothanaw danda7idaba gidiyako enti yarsho yarsheysa agganashin. Qassi goyinnanaw shiiqiya asay banta nagaraape geeyana; enta kahayka entana bala gidi mootenna.
Shin he yarshoti laythan laythan nagara qofisoosona.
Ayis giiko, korma suuthinne deesha suuthi nagara digganaw danda7enna.
Hessa gisho, Kiristoosi ha alamiya yida wode haysada yaagis:

content.text: Godaw, taani ne sheniya oothanaw yas’ yaagas”

content: yaagis.
Yarshoy yarshetana mela higgey kiittiyaba gidikoka, Kiristoosi koyro, “Neeni yarshonne imo, xuussa yarshonne nagara yarsho koyabaaka; entan ufaytabaaka” yaagis.
Kaallidika I, “Godaw, Heko taani ne sheniya oothanaw yas” yaagis. Hessa gisho, Kiristoosi nam7anthuwa essanaw koyroysa shaaris.
Yesuus Kiristoosi Xoossaa sheniya oothidi, zaarethonna ogen issi toho ba ashuwa yarshida gisho nuuni geeyida.
Kahine ubbay, nagara digganaw danda7onna he yarshota gallas gallas yarshishe eqidi ba oosuwa oothees.
Shin Kiristoosi ubba wodes gidiya issi nagara yarshuwa yarshidi, Xoossaafe ushacha baggan uttis.
He wodiyape doomidi iya morketi iya tohoy yedhiyabaa oothana gakanaw naagees.
I zaarethonna ogen issi toho bana yarshida yarshuwan geeshshata merinaw polo oothis.
Qassi Geeshsha Ayyaanay nuus haysa markatees. Koyro haysada yaagis:

content.text: Taani ta higgiya enta qofan wothana;

content: yaagees.
Kaallidika,
yaagees.
Hiza, nagari atto geetetidaape guye nagaras yarshetiya yarsho koshshenna.
Ane Xoossako Shiiqoos
Hiza, ta ishato, nuuni Yesuusa suuthaa baggara Ubbaafe Geeshsha Bessaa gelanaw nuus minotethi de7ees.
Nu gelanay Kiristoosi ba magarajuwa, hessika ba ashuwa baggara nuus dooyida oorathinne de7o gidida ogiyana.
Nuus Xoossa Keetha bolla shuumetida gita kahine halaqay de7ees.
Nuuni iita kahape geeyanaw nu wozanaa wurxetidi, nu asatethaa xillo haathan meecetidi, suure wozananinne polo ammanon Xoossaako shiiqoos.
Nuus ufaysa qaala immida Xoossay ammanetidaysa gidiya gisho nu markatiya ufaysaa ushachi haddirsi goonna minthidi oykoos.
Issoy issuwa siiqosinne lo77o oosos waati denthethaneko ane qopoos.
Issoti issoti meeze oothidi shiiqeysa aggidaysada nuuni issife shiiqeysa aggoko. Shin Godaa gallasay matatidaysa hinte be7iya gisho hessa kaseysafe aathidi oothite.
Nuuni tuma eratethaa ekidaape guye erishe nagara oothiko, hizape nu nagaraa gisho yashetana yarshoy baawa.
Shin hiza attiday yashshiya pirdaanne Xoossaa morketa xuugganaw giigida wolqaama tama.
Muse higgiya kiitetonna ixida oonika nam7u woyko heedzu asi iya bolla markatiko qadhey baynashin hayqees.
Yaatin, Xoossaa Na7aa kadhida uray, bana geeshshida Xoossaa caaqo suuthaa tunabaada qopida uray, qassi aadho keehatetha Ayyaana cayida uray, ay mela iita pirdaa ekanaw bessiyako ane qopite.
Hiza, “Halo kesoy tabaa, ta kushe zaarana” gidaysa nu eroos. Qassika, “Goday ba asa pirdana” yaagis.
De7o Xoossaa kushen kundethi daro yashshees.
Hintew Xoossaa poo7oy poo7idaape guye hinte daro waayen, gita baaxen gencida beni wodiya qopite.
Issi issi toho hinte asa sinthan cayetideta; goodetideta; issi issi toho hessa mela waayey gakida asaara issife waayideta.
Qashon de7iya asaaska qadhetideta. Hintew lo77onne dhayonna shaloy salon de7eysa hinte erida gisho hinte shaloy bonqetiya wode ufaysan danda7ideta.
Hessa gisho, gita woytoy de7iya hinte minotethaa yeggofite.
Xoossaa sheniya polidi, I hintew immana gida ufaysaa ekana gakanaw gencanaw koshshees.
Hiza, Geeshsha Maxaafan,

content.text: Shin ta xilloy, tanan ammanetidi daana;

content: yaagees.
Nuuni ammanidi attiya asaa baggafe attishin, guye simmidi dhayiya asaa bagga gidoko.
